name: e2e
title_zh: 跑一次就知道哪条用例会挂在哪个选择器上
tagline_zh: 在 Gramax 里写 Playwright 用例，不用来回切文档猜 API。它直接读你的代码上下文，把断言。
tagline_en: Write Playwright tests inside Gramax without flipping docs. It reads your code context, nails assertions, waits.
desc_en: Use when user asks to write, create, run, or debug Playwright e2e tests in the Gramax project. Triggers on keywords like e2e, playwright, test, spec, QA.
why_zh: 它不生成模板，而是先扫你仓库里已有的 page object 和测试习惯，再按你的风格补用例。
why_en: It doesn't emit boilerplate. It scans your existing page objects and test style, writes matching specs, and translates failure.
limit_zh: 只认 Gramax 仓库内的 Playwright 项目；不会装浏览器驱动，也不管 CI 配置。
limit_en: Only for Playwright projects inside the Gramax repo. Won't install browser drivers or touch CI. Files outside the repo are ignored unless you point.
title_en: Run once and see exactly which selector your e2e test.
